# Quiet UI Skills (`quiet-ui` + `quiet-evidence` + `quiet-bridge`) v9.6

> 100% first-party, zero-dependency design system and deterministic engineering compiler suite unifying **7 physical delivery mediums (`quiet-ui`)**, **6 calibrated evidence & open-standards SVG compilers (`quiet-evidence`)**, and **audience communication vectors (`quiet-bridge`)** on one 4-theme CSS token palette.

- **v9.6 Multi-Domain Interactive Studio (`6 Domains · 22 Views`):** `quiet-ui-showcase.html` (Overview Landing Page, Light Topbar, `1080p` Framed Portal, Interactive `#va-shell-rail`, GitHub Pages: `docs/index.html`)
- **3-Pillar Component Library (`50 Compiled Specimens`):** `docs/bench/evidence-bench.html` (Quiet SVG | Live Apache ECharts + Civic Tile Maps/Arrow Dumbbells/Subgroup Bars/Dual Slopegraphs/Diverging Matrices + Copy-for-AI Takeaway Cards + 4-Phase Alarm Specimen + Data Contracts)
- **Repository:** https://github.com/FrankXLT/quiet-ui-skills
- **Bundled Pillars:** `quiet-ui` (7 Mediums · N0–N4 Morphing Shells · `.quiet-ui.md` Contract) + `quiet-evidence` (Calibrated Plots, Waveforms, Bitfields & Open-Standards Schematics) + `quiet-bridge` (Audience Translation & Plain-English Rationale)
- **License:** Apache 2.0 (Core 3-Pillar Plugin) + MIT (Customizations, Tokens & 100% of Generated UI/SVG Deliverables)

## 1. Installation & Quick Start

```bash
git clone https://github.com/FrankXLT/quiet-ui-skills.git
cd quiet-ui-skills
./install.sh
```

Installs the native **Quiet UI Skills** plugin into `~/.gemini/config/plugins/quiet-ui-skills/` and standalone skills into `~/.agents/skills/{quiet-ui,quiet-evidence,quiet-bridge}/`.

### Customize in 60 Seconds (`customizations/`)
One manifest (`customizations/<name>/customization.json`) skins UI shells and every compiled SVG schematic simultaneously:
- **`customizations/personal-starter/`**: Full-range blueprint (22 views across 6 domains) for personal research, telemetry, optical viewport HUD, and tactile consoles.
- **`customizations/brand-starter/`**: Product blueprint (18 views across Domains 01–05) for enterprise documentation, workflows, roadmaps, public data briefs, and engineering workspaces.

```bash
python3 customizations/scripts/build_showcase.py customizations/<target>
python3 customizations/scripts/verify_customization.py customizations/<target> --check-immutability
```

## 2. Shared Architectural Contracts (`quiet-ui` + `quiet-evidence` + `quiet-bridge`)

1. **Self-Immutability Lock & Persistent `.quiet-ui.md`:** `skills/quiet-ui/`, `skills/quiet-evidence/`, `skills/quiet-bridge/`, `customizations/personal-starter/`, and `customizations/brand-starter/` are strictly read-only during user workflows. Always check the target repo for `.quiet-ui.md` before re-running intake (`audit_quiet_html.py --init-context`).
2. **4-Theme CSS Token Cohesion & 4-Way SHA-256 Parity:** All 3 pillars bind surfaces, ink, hairlines, and semantic tints to `tokens/quiet-ui-tokens.css` (`data-theme="white|paper|dark-paper|dark"`, defaulting to `white`), mirrored across `tokens/`, `skills/quiet-ui/tokens/`, and both starter kits.
3. **Fluid 4K Root Scale & 3-Role Font Stack:**
   - Fluid 4K root: `clamp(16px, calc(12.4px + 0.25vw), 22px)` with `11px` hard legibility floor (`--ts-xs`).
   - `--font-sans` (`Inter`, system sans + `tabular-nums`) for navigation, kickers, controls, and headings.
   - `--font-serif` (`Newsreader`, `Georgia`) strictly for monograph prose and display H1.
   - `--font-mono` (`JetBrains Mono`, `ui-monospace`) strictly for machine literals, telemetry readouts, register bits, and code.
4. **Concentric Border-Radius Math & NASA Human-Factors Invariants:**
   - `--radius-inner: max(0px, calc(var(--radius-card, 8px) - var(--inset-pad, 4px)))` across `auto|sharp|subtle|rounded|soft`.
   - NASA-STD-3001/HIDH rules: telemetry vs effectors separation, `CMD`/`ACT` feedback, 2-step guarded actuation (`ARM` -> `EXECUTE`), quiet cockpit nominal neutrality, and `STALE` flags.
5. **Data-First Widget Binding (`skills/quiet-ui/foundation/data-grounding-and-widget-binding.md`):**
   - Inspect live schemas and produce a **Data-to-Widget Binding Map** *before* picking specimens. Omit absent target/delta sub-slots, never borrow targets across pools, evaluate pricing changes per immutable `effective_from` rate epoch, sanitize public showcase snapshots via deterministic `SHA-256[:12]` aliasing + `0`-match grep gate, show `Warming up — N samples collected` when `N < 10`, avoid retroactive scoring against newly added rules, and keep inline mock JS arrays, `Quiet` self-badges, and raw `brain:` IDs out of app chrome.

## 3. Pillar 1 — `quiet-ui` (7 Delivery Mediums, Forms, Public Data & Print Gates)

- `M1` — Paper & Ink Print Sheets (unboxed, `@media print` optimized)
- `M2` — Editorial Web Monographs, Question-First Briefs, Multi-Format Decks (`16:9` + Web Brief + Print) & Two-Column Proof Layouts (`>= 35ch` / `72ch`)
- `M3` — Stateful Web Workbenches, `.va-stage[data-stage="canvas|workbench|ops"]` + `[data-width="reading|workbench"]` (`112rem` cap), `.va-workbench-panes` / `.va-pane` / `.va-pane-hdr` hairline columns, sticky topbar trigger + auto-closing opaque `.va-side-rail[data-mode="overlay"]` + single-row `40px` `.va-rail-footer` (`.va-swatch-row`/`.va-swatch-btn` left + `Compact -> d3` / `Comfortable -> d2` right, `[DENSITY_STOP_SPRAWL]`, `[RAIL_FOOTER_CLUTTER]`), single-owner nav (`N4` hides `.va-tab-strip`, `<= 22%` chrome budget), flat borderless `20px`-caret `.va-tree-row` + `2.25rem` `.va-tree-children` indent (`<= 5` items + `.va-tree-more`), `.va-toolbar-joined` segmented track, `.va-split-reader-gallery` (`>= 60%` prose `>= 760px` + `< 760px` `<dialog class="va-modal-sheet" closedby="any">`), `.va-form-grid` / `.va-empty-state` (4-way zero-states incl. `filtered` `Clear filters` `[DEAD_END_ZERO_STATE]` & `.va-stale-retained`) / `>= 7s` `.va-undo-toast`, bounded `.va-period-stepper`, `QuietSankeyLayout`, `.va-kpi-gauge-card` + trackless `.va-kpi-card`, Guardrail 6 Day-30 Extract & Normalize (`--strict-drift`: `[TOKEN_BYPASS_HEX]`, `[INLINE_STYLE_SPRAWL]`, `[BLOCKLIST_RESURRECTION]`), Guardrail 7 parity (`audit_workbench_probes.py`), and `audit_editorial_print.py` (`[PRINT_FLOW_COLLISION]`, `[PROSE_COLUMN_STARVATION]`, `[NESTED_PROSE_SCROLL]`, `[CODE_LUMINANCE_SHOCK]`, `[DIAGONAL_TICK_OR_ROTATED_Y_TITLE]`, `[END_LABEL_CLIP]`)
- `M4` — Walk-Up POI Terminals & Guarded Industrial SCADA Consoles
- `M5` — 10-Foot Ambient Wall Displays (`>= 32px` KPIs, zero decorative chrome)
- `M6` — Collimated Optical HUDs (`>= 65%` unobstructed central keep-out zone)
- `M7` — Transparent Smart-Glass Overlays (`>= 7.0:1` peripheral smoked scrims)

## 4. Pillar 2 — `quiet-evidence` (6 Deterministic Evidence Modalities)

- **Modalities (`compile_evidence.py` & `window.QuietSvgLayout`):** `scalars` (linear range/threshold gauges & trackless `.va-kpi-card` metrics), `tables` (Booktabs, `diverging_matrix`, & `N <= 8` `.va-inline-bar` bullet rows), `waveforms` (linked clinical/HIL/reflection multi-channel scopes), `plots` (calibrated Cartesian/calibration curves, stacked bars, dumbbell, forest, `gantt`, `heatmap`, `us_hex_tile_map`, `arrow_dumbbell`, `paired_subgroup_bars`, `dual_slopegraph`; browser Takeaway Figure Cards with `[Chart | Table]`, TSV `Copy data`, and Markdown `Copy for AI` via `quiet-card-export.js`; ECharts bundles `QuietEChartsDefaults` for `binTimeSeries`, `buildCyclicalWhiskerOption`, `trimTrailingFutureWeeks`, `alignPlotGridFrames`), `bitfields`, and `schematics`.

## 5. Reference Map

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Repository map, build/verify commands, and strict invariants for coding agents.
- [plugin.json](plugin.json): Native Antigravity plugin manifest (`quiet-ui-skills` v9.6.0).
- [skills/quiet-ui/SKILL.md](skills/quiet-ui/SKILL.md): Pillar 1 Delivery Medium Physics router (`M1–M7`), [public-data-and-storytelling.md](skills/quiet-ui/foundation/public-data-and-storytelling.md), [brownfield-retrofit-and-migration.md](skills/quiet-ui/foundation/brownfield-retrofit-and-migration.md), [forms-states-and-resilience.md](skills/quiet-ui/foundation/forms-states-and-resilience.md), [data-grounding-and-widget-binding.md](skills/quiet-ui/foundation/data-grounding-and-widget-binding.md), and portable auditor (`audit_quiet_html.py`, `audit_editorial_print.py`, `audit_ux_and_drift.py`).
- [skills/quiet-evidence/SKILL.md](skills/quiet-evidence/SKILL.md): Pillar 2 deterministic compiler, portable assets (`assets/quiet-evidence-bundle.{css,js}` + CJK-safe `window.QuietSvgLayout`), and metrology router (`6` modalities).
- [skills/quiet-bridge/SKILL.md](skills/quiet-bridge/SKILL.md): Pillar 3 audience translation & `.quiet-ui.md`-aware intake router.
- [docs/WORKFLOWS.md](docs/WORKFLOWS.md): End-to-end 3-pillar workflows (A–E), Guardrail 6 drift normalization, 4-variant pill grammar, and verification lifecycle.
- [scripts/build_all.py](scripts/build_all.py): Canonical single-command artifact synchronizer & `--check` drift gate.
- [tests/](tests/): Unified stdlib (`test_compilers.py`, `test_corpora.py`, `test_portable_auditor.py`, `test_repo_hygiene.py`, `test_v940_context_forms_drift.py`, `test_v960_civic_and_print_audit.py`) and Chrome CDP (`test_cdp_visuals.py`) suite.
- [tokens/quiet-ui-tokens.css](tokens/quiet-ui-tokens.css): Standalone 4-theme CSS Custom Properties (MIT).
- [customizations/README.md](customizations/README.md): 60-second brand & personal onboarding guide (MIT).
